recognize_zh: 高細胞量骨髓切片中，中央一個圓形脂肪空泡周圍環繞著淡染、帶小空泡的組織球（foamy histiocytes）與少量淋巴球，形成小型肉芽腫樣結構，這就是脂肪肉芽腫（lipogranuloma / fat granuloma）。
features: Hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and interspersed fat spaces
Central lipid vacuole rimmed by histiocytes with pale eosinophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Small clear lipid droplets within and around the histiocytic collection
Admixed lymphocytes and occasional eosinophils; no necrosis or multinucleated giant cells
Adjacent erythroid precursors and granulocytic cells; focal hemorrhage
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis. A small lipogranuloma is present, composed of histiocytes with pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm surrounding a central lipid vacuole, with admixed small lipid droplets, lymphocytes and occasional eosinophils. There is no caseous necrosis or well-formed epithelioid granuloma with giant cells. Findings are consistent with a fat granuloma (lipogranuloma), a common incidental finding of no specific diagnostic significance; special stains for organisms are not indicated by this morphology alone.

ddx.vs: Infectious granulomas are compact aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes, often with Langhans giant cells or necrosis, and lack a central fat vacuole.
Gaucher cells form sheets of large histiocytes with fibrillary tissue-paper cytoplasm rather than a small cluster around a fat droplet.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin lymphoma or T-cell lymphoma with histiocytes
ddx.vs: Lymphoma shows atypical large cells (e.g., CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells) within a polymorphous infiltrate rather than bland foamy histiocytes.
